name: What preparations are needed before starting a granny flat project with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What preparations are needed before starting a granny flat project with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before commencing a granny flat project, homeowners should consider their specific needs for the space, including its intended use and desired amenities. Gathering any existing property surveys, understanding local zoning considerations, and having a clear vision for the aesthetic and functional requirements are helpful first steps. AKN Design Group will guide you through the detailed planning stages to ensure a customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before starting, consider the granny flat's intended use and desired amenities, and gather property surveys to help AKN Design Group with detailed planning.
